footnote_text: The corporation transferred all 14,665,694 common shares it then held to Kelly White personally for no cash consideration. Its common-share holding became zero. The ending common holding comprises 11,665,694 previously held shares plus the 3,000,000 acquired. || This report discloses the corporation's previously omitted acquisition.
